messages:
Harper Lee: Dropping a compact mock for the alerting preview that fits in a narrow side panel. Goal: show route match, suppression state, and next fallback in one column. GIF in drive.
Omar Ruiz: Nice. How does the compact view indicate timing? small clocks or inline text?
Harper Lee: Inline text pair: relative time + small clock icon, e.g., 'in 3m ⏱'. Keeps things terse. Full timeline expands into a modal.
Tess Nguyen: Accessibility: relative times can be ambiguous for screen readers. Add a title attribute with absolute time and aria-describedby linking to a detailed timestamp.
Ravi Patel: Copy nit: currently label reads "Suppression" then a boolean badge. Suggest: change to "Notifications paused" with a secondary line "until 2026-11-07 03:00 UTC". Clearer for non-ops readers.
Harper Lee: Good point. We'll use "Notifications paused" in the compact view and keep "Suppressed" in the audit log.
a11y-bot: Also ensure the small clock icon has aria-hidden=true and its meaning is conveyed in adjacent text. Keyboard focus order should go: route name -> suppression status -> fallback info -> actions.
Omar Ruiz: When fallback is imminent, can we flash a subtle pulse on the channel pill (not red) and provide a tooltip: "Fallback will attempt SMS at 03:00 UTC"?
Tess Nguyen: Don't rely on color alone. Add an icon state + text and include a live region announcing "Fallback scheduled in 5 minutes" when the preview is open.
Ravi Patel: UX ask: if a route is org-locked, show a condensed message: "Managed by org policy" with a link to view policy and a small chevron to expand. If user has override rights, show "Request local override" CTA.
Harper Lee: For the compact editor, reordering channels should be inline via small up/down chevrons. Drag handles reserved for expanded edit mode. Keyboard users get move up/down buttons.
Omar Ruiz: Quick data question: do we show estimated deliverability? like "ETA 2m, 95% delivery" for push channels. Might be too much for compact view.
Harper Lee: Keep it minimal. We'll show deliverability in expanded modal and include a tiny info icon in compact view that opens the modal.
Tess Nguyen: Microcopy tweak: change "Pin at org level" -> "Enforce org policy" where relevant. Also confirm what "acknowledged" means in the help text.
Ravi Patel: Backend will treat any manual ack in PagerDuty or an explicit "Acknowledge" action in the UI as acknowledged. Slack thread replies won't auto-ack unless marked. We'll add that to help text.
a11y-bot: Final note: ensure contrast for the compact pill variants and provide text labels for each pill (e.g., "SMS ($)", "Slack"). Patterns for heat/intensity recommended for colorblind users.
design-bot: Reminder: critique Friday 11am PT. Add updated artboards to Drive by tomorrow noon.
Harper Lee: Uploading compact artboards: https://drive.redwood/design/compact-alert-preview-iter1. Will follow up with expanded modal mocks.
Omar Ruiz: Thanks — will review and test keyboard flows.
Tess Nguyen: I'll draft the aria strings for the live region and timestamp titles.
Harper Lee: Thanks all, closing thread. If anything tiny pops up, drop a comment on the figma.
